reviews.text: It was a wonderful service. My dog, who had collapsed once, recovered thanks to the doctor's treatment. He lived for 5 months before passing away. Thank you very much.
Professor Ueno is always as polite and kind as ever.
We are so grateful to the foster families who took care of the dogs during the rescue activities, as well as to the elderly dogs we adopted. Everyone, especially the veterinarian, is very kind.

We had been taking care of our dog since she was 0 years old, and she passed away at 13 years and 10 months. We are so grateful for all the care we received, including examinations, grooming, and boarding. The head veterinarian and staff were all very kind and attentive. The explanations of her condition were easy to understand, which gave us great peace of mind.

I was a patient for 17 years. The doctor was very kind and helpful, and assisted me with all sorts of things. When I went to report that my beloved cat had passed away, they sent me flowers. I am truly grateful from beginning to end. I wouldn't have been able to spend so much time with my cat without the doctor. Thank you so much.
Everyone is friendly, and you can get an appointment without one.

The doctor was kind. The waiting time was short, and the explanations were easy to understand. My beloved cat and dog were saved.

It's truly appreciated that they respond appropriately and quickly to emergencies.

We primarily use their pet hotel services, but occasionally bring our pet in for checkups.

The staff are wonderful and warm, and my family says they feel completely at ease leaving their pet in their care.

We would like to continue using their services in the future.

I cared for both my elderly dog ​​(who passed away at the age of 19 years and 40 days) and my elderly cat (who passed away at the age of 17 years and 11 months).
The director's explanations were very easy to understand, and he did his best, so I'm very grateful.

There were times when the grooming was a bit tricky.
